record.provider: Comet ML (Comet / Opik) — artifact + dataset management

free_tier.stated: No storage allowance at all on the free tier. The free cloud plan is metered in spans, not bytes: 'Up to 10 team members · 25k spans per month · 60-day data retention'. Artifact/dataset management is a paid-MLOps feature; the free plan is the Opik observability product with a 60-day retention clamp.

retention.stated: The free cloud plan is metered in spans, not bytes: 'Up to 10 team members · 25k spans per month · 60-day data retention'

egress.terms: Not applicable. There is no free storage pool to egress from.

record.tooling: Comet_ml Python SDK (log_artifact, log_dataset), plus Opik's own SDK. Self-hostable: github.com/comet-ml/opik is open source, which is the only unlimited path. On your own disks.
record.chaining: None. With no free byte allowance, multiplying accounts multiplies zero.
record.limits_note: 25k spans/month, 10 team members, 60-day data retention on Free. Retention is the killer: 60 days is a hard clamp, so this cannot hold an archive even if bytes were free.

identity_cost.detail: email; academic Pro requires institutional verification.

record.reliability_note: Free tier enforces an automatic 60-day retention limit that cannot be overridden by client settings.

evidence.proved: read live: Free Cloud '$0 ... Up to 10 team members · 25k spans per month · 60-day data retention'; Pro Cloud '$19 ... 100k spans per month · 60-day data retention'

read live: 'Our MLOps platform is designed for teams building and training machine learning models, with tools for experiment tracking, dataset management, model versioning' — i.e. dataset management is the MLOps product, not the free Opik one
